_colors_note: FLAKE swatches are the client's own product photos (supplied Aug 26 2026), ordered dark -> light. METALLIC swatches are still rendered colour REPRESENTATIONS, not photos of installed floors, and the page says so. Replace any file in assets/img/colors/ using the same filename and the page updates itself.

verification._googleDnsTxt_note: Supplied Aug 27 2026 for a Google Search Console DOMAIN property. This is a DNS TXT record - it is added at Vercel (the nameservers for this domain), NOT in this repo. Stored here only so it is not lost. See SEARCH-CONSOLE.md.
verification._googleSiteVerification_note: OPTIONAL alternative route. If you verify with Search Console's 'HTML tag' method instead of DNS, paste ONLY the content token here (not the whole tag) and rebuild - it renders into every page's <head>. Google issues a DIFFERENT token per method, so the DNS value above will NOT work here.
verification._bingSiteVerification_note: Bing Webmaster Tools msvalidate.01 token, if you verify by meta tag rather than importing from Google. Leave empty to omit.

integrations._leadConnector_note: GoHighLevel / LeadConnector chat widget. Set to "" to remove it from all 32 pages in one edit. It is deliberately NOT on /review/ or /feedback/ - those are one-screen utility pages and a chat bubble would cover the stars - nor on the standalone funnel/, which has its own conversion path.
